pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When you ask a question in French, what should your voice do at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Go down
   B. Become louder only
   C. Go up
   D. Stay silent

2. Which of these is said as sa-LÜ? (1 mark)
   A. au revoir
   B. bonjour
   C. salut
   D. merci

3. What does 'salut' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. yes
   C. thank you
   D. hi, bye

4. How do you say 'Put the book in the bedroom.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est un lit.
   B. Le livre est sur la table.
   C. Mets le livre dans la chambre.
   D. Le sac est dans la chambre.

5. How do you say 'Where is the cat?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   C. Où est le chat ?
   D. Mets le livre dans la chambre.

6. What number is 'un' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 1
   C. 19
   D. 4

7. What number is 'vingt-cinq' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 12
   C. 10
   D. 25

8. What number is 'dix-sept' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 31
   C. 25
   D. 17

9. What does 'les fruits' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the banana
   B. fruits
   C. fish
   D. the carrot

10. What does 'le jus' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. beans
   B. milk
   C. juice
   D. the mango

11. How do you say 'I have a nose.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai un nez.
   B. Touche ton nez !
   C. J'ai deux mains.
   D. Il est grand.

12. What does 'le soleil' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the weather
   B. the sun
   C. a flood
   D. the snow

13. What does 'beaucoup' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is cold.
   B. the snow
   C. a lot
   D. It is raining.

14. How do you say 'Excuse me, where is the school?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   B. Où est la clé ?
   C. Tournez à gauche.
   D. Elle est sous la chaise.

15. What does 'à droite' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. near
   B. straight ahead
   C. to the left
   D. to the right

16. What does 'à côté de' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. straight ahead
   B. next to
   C. to the right
   D. to the left

17. What does 'Au revoir, Monsieur.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye, Sir.
   B. Hi, Kamau!
   C. Pleased to meet you!
   D. Yes, I am fine.

18. What does 'Ce sont des oranges.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. They are oranges.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. What is it?
   D. I do not like fish.

19. Which little word goes with 'mangue' (the mango)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. le
   C. les
   D. la

20. Which little word goes with 'nez' (the nose)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. les

21. What does 'Il neige.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is snowing.
   B. It is cold.
   C. It is cloudy.
   D. I stay in the house.

22. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'baby'? (1 mark)
   A. béé
   B. bébé
   C. bèbé
   D. bebe

23. How do you say 'the church' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'église
   B. la semaine
   C. le jour
   D. l'école

24. Which month has an accent aigu on the first é? (1 mark)
   A. juin
   B. février
   C. avril
   D. mars

25. How do you say the month 'April' in French? (1 mark)
   A. juillet
   B. juin
   C. novembre
   D. avril

26. How do you write the number 16 in French? (1 mark)
   A. huit
   B. quatorze
   C. seize
   D. trente et un

27. Which spelling is correct? (1 mark)
   A. the
   B. thé
   C. thée
   D. té

28. How do you say 'the hand' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le ventre
   B. le genou
   C. l'épaule
   D. la main

29. How do you say 'the rain' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le nuage
   B. l'orage
   C. la pluie
   D. le temps

30. How do you say 'the wind' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le soleil
   B. la pluie
   C. la neige
   D. le vent

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: 'Joyeux anniversaire !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

32. Describe a friend in three sentences in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into French: 'It is on the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into French: 'The cat is behind the door.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into English: 'Je bois un jus.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Translate into French: 'There is a cake and there are balloons.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

37. Translate into English: 'C'est bon pour la santé.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Write three sentences in French to say where objects are in a room. Use three different position words. (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'Here is my family.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Write a small menu of four foods in French. (4 marks) (4 marks)

41. Translate into English: 'La télé est dans le salon.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'And you?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Sort five foods into good for health and eat little, in French. (5 marks) (5 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Une semaine, sept jours.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'The bag is in the bedroom.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Il y a un canapé dans le salon.' (4 marks) (4 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Go up
   A question ends with a rising voice.

2. C — salut
   Salut is said sa-LÜ and the final t is silent.

3. D — hi, bye
   salut means hi, bye.

4. C — Mets le livre dans la chambre.
   Put the book in the bedroom. in French is Mets le livre dans la chambre.

5. C — Où est le chat ?
   Where is the cat? in French is Où est le chat ?

6. B — 1
   un means 1.

7. D — 25
   vingt-cinq means 25.

8. D — 17
   dix-sept means 17.

9. B — fruits
   les fruits means fruits.

10. C — juice
   le jus means juice.

11. A — J'ai un nez.
   I have a nose. in French is J'ai un nez.

12. B — the sun
   le soleil means the sun.

13. C — a lot
   beaucoup means a lot.

14. A — Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   Excuse me, where is the school? in French is Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?

15. D — to the right
   à droite means to the right.

16. B — next to
   à côté de means next to.

17. A — Goodbye, Sir.
   Au revoir, Monsieur. means Goodbye, Sir.

18. A — They are oranges.
   Ce sont des oranges. means They are oranges.

19. D — la
   mangue is feminine, so we say la mangue.

20. B — le
   nez is masculine, so we say le nez.

21. A — It is snowing.
   Il neige. means It is snowing.

22. B — bébé
   The correct spelling is bébé, with its accents.

23. A — l'église
   the church in French is l'église.

24. B — février
   Février has é.

25. D — avril
   April in French is avril.

26. C — seize
   16 in French is seize.

27. B — thé
   Thé has an accent aigu.

28. D — la main
   the hand in French is la main.

29. C — la pluie
   the rain in French is la pluie.

30. D — le vent
   the wind in French is le vent.

35. (3 marks)
